findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x_search, x_profile, x_digest, x_ticker_pulse, pm_search, pm_ticker_events, pm_gaps, sec_insider, x_person, x_leads_deep, web_answer · Private data: find_agent_tools, token_verdict, x_person, x_leads_deep, buy_credits · Public sink: request_agent_tool, send_feedback, x_digest, x_ticker_pulse, token_verdict, buy_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x_search, x_profile, x_digest, x_ticker_pulse, pm_search, pm_ticker_events, pm_gaps, sec_insider, x_person, x_leads_deep, web_answer · Private data: find_agent_tools, token_verdict, x_person, x_leads_deep, buy_credits · Public sink: request_agent_tool, send_feedback, x_digest, x_ticker_pulse, token_verdict, buy_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
